description: This file defines a collection of tensor decomposition functions, utility functions, and registered implementations for various PyTorch operations using decorators like @register_decomposition. It covers backward functions, loss functions, tensor manipulation (e.g., slice, split, im2col), activation functions (e.g., tanh, sigmoid, hardswish), and normalization routines (e.g., rms_norm, layer_norm). The code is part of the decomposition module in PyTorch's internals, providing tensor operation decompositions for automatic differentiation and functional transformations.

classes.name: Reduction
classes.description: Enumeration for different loss reduction modes including NONE, MEAN, and SUM.

methods.name: type_casts
methods.description: Decorator that wraps a function to perform type promotion and casting on tensor arguments based on a specified promotion strategy.

methods.name: apply_loss_reduction(loss: Tensor, reduction: int)
methods.description: Applies the specified reduction mode (mean, sum, none) to the loss tensor.

methods.name: to_real_dtype
methods.description: Converts complex data types to their corresponding real data types for various operations.

methods.name: safe_softmax
methods.description: Computes softmax with masking of invalid rows where all values are -inf.

methods.name: log_softmax
methods.description: Computes log softmax similarly with masking, returning a contiguous tensor.

methods.name: embedding
methods.description: Implements an embedding lookup with support for padding index and optional gradient scaling.

methods.name: embedding_dense_backward
methods.description: Computes gradients of embedding weights during backpropagation, optionally scaling by frequency.

methods.name: prod
methods.description: Computes the product of dimensions in a list.

methods.name: slice_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for tensor slicing, scattering gradients into input shape.

methods.name: slice_forward
methods.description: Implements tensor slicing combined with tensor strides and storage offset calculations.

methods.name: slice_scatter
methods.description: Scatter the gradients back into the input tensor shape, normalizing start/end indices.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a tensor into chunks along a given dimension, supporting symbolic shape handling.

methods.name: split_with_sizes_copy
methods.description: Splits tensor and copies the parts to provided output tensors, respecting shape and dtype.

methods.name: unsafe_split
methods.description: Splits a tensor into equal chunks or a single chunk if split_size is 0.

methods.name: unsafe_split_with_sizes
methods.description: Splits tensor according to split sizes.

methods.name: tensor_split_tensor_indices_or_sections_py_impl
methods.description: Implementation of tensor split based on indices or sections specified in a tensor.

methods.name: addmm(self: Tensor, mat1: Tensor, mat2: Tensor, beta: int = 1, alpha: int = 1)
methods.description: Matrix multiplication with optional bias addition, with proper dtype casting and output handling.

methods.name: _addmm_activation( self: Tensor, mat1: Tensor, mat2: Tensor, beta: int = 1, alpha: int = 1, use_gelu: bool = False, )
methods.description: Performs addmm and optionally applies an activation like GELU or ReLU.

methods.name: addmv(self: Tensor, mat1: Tensor, vec: Tensor, beta: int = 1, alpha: int = 1)
methods.description: Performs matrix-vector multiplication with optional bias addition.

methods.name: native_group_norm_backward
methods.description: Computes gradients for group normalization backward pass.

methods.name: native_layer_norm_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for layer normalization, supporting optional gradient outputs.
